rv.q: Otherworld is a unique treasure; a company dedicated to Science Fiction and Fantasy Theatre.
A Midsummer Night Scream is ultimately limited by its desire to be horror, comedy, tragic romance, and Shakespeare sequel all in one.
What could have been a gimmick turns into an entertaining mash-up of two genres that probably shouldn't work together—but somehow do.

cn.t: Otherworld Theatre's inventive mash-up of Shakespeare and 80s slasher horror delights critics with its clever concept and striking production design, featuring an immersive forest set and period-perfect soundtrack.
